metadata.rules_text:
- Model consistently underestimates prices after recent spikes; apply upward bias correction for 3–5 days post-spike.
- Overestimates early in forecast horizon when sentiment is neutral or negative; reduce initial forecast values by 2–5% for 1–3 day lead.
- Mean reversion bias: if 30d forecast is >35.0, reduce by 1–3% per day until price stabilizes below 35.0.
- If sentiment history is all 0.00, assume no market sentiment influence; apply no adjustment unless price deviates >5% from 14d moving average.
- Overshoot correction: if forecast > true outcome by >3% for 3 consecutive days, reduce next forecast by 1–2% to avoid overcorrection.
- Horizon-specific: 1–3 day forecasts often lag; add 0.5–1.5% to forecast for immediate price movement.
- If true outcome shows sharp upward trend after 10–15 days, model tends to underestimate; increase forecast by 1–3% for next 3–5 days.
